[element-sub-part-number]
=== `<sub-part-number>` Document Sub-part Number

The <<element-part-number,`<part-number>`>> gives the part number of the document, for individual parts of multipart documents. For some standards organizations, the part- number granularity is insufficient, and the `<part-number>` can be used to hold sub-part numbers, for sections and similar components of parts.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-std-ident,`<std-ident>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA)*

#### Tagged Sample

##### A part divided into numbered sections
[source,xml]
....
...
<std-ident>
  <originator>IEC</originator>
  <doc-type>is</doc-type>
  <doc-number>60034</doc-number>
  <part-number>18</part-number>
  <sub-part-number content-type="section">41</sub-part-number>
...
</std-ident>...
....
